fieldValues.title: How is confidence computed, and where does it live?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (3. Confidence instead of a gate), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. A score computed by clerk's care policy from the records and relations, not stored.
- B. A field stored on each record, updated by agents.
- C. Strength stored on relations in the data model, reopening the 4f1e12e5 removal.
- D. Derived on read by a core service, so every client sees the same value.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Who needs confidence (care modes, readers, the desk) and whether it must be identical across clients.
fieldValues.next_action: Compute a simple cross-check score for the 23 problems in the graph and affirmation threads and see whether it matches the owner's sense.
